unresolved_choices: The admitted first-party sources publish overall length but not configuration-specific overall width or height; public-envelope Y and Z remain unresolved.
The visible 2.980 m track envelope is evidence-derived from 2.218 m center spacing plus one 0.762 m belt width, not a manufacturer-published overall-width claim.
Track pad, drive-lug, sprocket, idler, midroller, frame, tensioning, oscillation and axle geometry are not published.
Articulation gudgeon, oscillation pivot, cylinders, anchors, hard stops and cab-to-frame transforms are not published.
Exact body panels, cab/glazing, cooling, aftertreatment, lighting, hoses, wiring, ballast and service hardware remain unresolved.
Manufacturer colors, graphics, badges and decals are outside the public structural study.
boundary: MY2025 North American 9RX 640 code 9540RW candidate with JD14, e18, base 30-inch AG3500 tracks at 87-inch spacing, less PTO and less rear hitch. Official sources constrain identity, code selections, length, track belt and spacing, drawbar, wheelbase and articulated/oscillating topology. Overall width/height, belt mechanics and hidden articulation geometry remain derived, reconstructed or unresolved. Neutral unbranded visualization only; not manufacturer CAD, a traction model, an engineering solver, safety guidance or proof of one delivered serial-number machine.
